Fed cuts rates, Asian markets react

Jane Reporter John Editor
Oct 5, 2026

The Federal Reserve cut its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points overnight.

Asian markets responded positively in early trade, with the Nikkei up 1.2% and Shanghai Composite gaining 0.8%.

Analysts expect two more cuts before year-end if inflation continues to ease.
